Theme

Computing & programming

tester noun

also QA tester

* our formation

* (our own formation) probātor, probātōris m.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

approver

Also examiner in ecclesiastical Latin. Applied here to a software tester.

Other words

  • * (our own formation) probātrīx, probātrīcis f. — tester (a woman)

    noun, third declension · also used · * our formation · Declension on Wiktionary

    Our transparent feminine formation; its software use is not independently verified.

  • * (our own formation) probātor programmatum — tester of programs

    also used · * our formation

    programmatum is the genitive plural of programma, programmatis n., with short stem a.

  • * (our own formation) probātrīx programmatum — a female tester of programs

    also used · * our formation

  • * (our own formation) artifex probātiōnis quālitātis — a quality-testing specialist

    also used · * our formation

    A longer descriptive proposal from the earlier conversation. artifex, artificis m./f. denotes a skilled practitioner; it is not an established translation of the job title “QA engineer.”

Examples

  • Probātor mendum invēnit.

    The tester found a bug.composed

See also testing, quality assurance, bug.
